title: Componentized cadence playbook for hosted endpoints & model fleet
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: As usage of Hosted endpoints grows we need a repeatable, componentized quarterly planning playbook that aligns the Hosted API roadmap with model catalog churn so engineering, infra, and GTM can predict capacity, guardrails, and rollout windows. Current planning artifacts are large monolith documents and ad-hoc meetings; this causes missed capacity hedges, last-minute canaries, and unclear OKR links.

Goals:
- Produce a concise playbook (componentized template) that teams can reuse every quarter to define commitment lanes, dependency maps, and rollout windows for hosted endpoints + model catalog changes.
- Surface concrete SLO/throughput thresholds that map to capacity hedges.
- Ensure cross-functional signoffs (SRE, Runtime, Console, Sales Ops, CS) before model activation.
- Bake in an evaluation checklist (performance, quantization impact, fallbacks) that gates catalog rollout.

Deliverables:
1) Componentized Playbook doc (Confluence) with: alignment lanes, staging schedule template, rollback criteria, monitoring dashboards checklist, and pre-launch runbook.
2) A lightweight template for per-model RFEs to capture perf regressions, KV/cache expectations, and quantized profile needed for Dedicated/private customers.
3) A gating checklist integrated with the release calendar and the Console rollout UI (links for ops).
4) A post-launch signal dashboard template (Datadog/Grafana) to track per-model latency, token-cost delta, error budget burn, and customer-impact signals.

Milestones & Acceptance Criteria:
- Week 1: Draft playbook + stakeholder walkthrough (acceptance: signoff from Runtime PM and SRE lead).
- Week 2: Add gating checklist and integrate with current release calendar (acceptance: release calendar entry + example model onboarding).
- Week 3: Template dashboards wired to synthetic canary tests (acceptance: dashboard shows baseline vs candidate).
- Week 4: Docs finalized and small pilot for two model swaps on Hosted endpoints (acceptance: successful canary with rollback enacted and a short retro).

Metrics / OKR mapping:
- OKR: Reduce hosted inference regressions during model rotations by 50% this quarter. Metric: number of production rollbacks and customer-facing incidents tied to model swaps.
- OKR: Improve model onboarding lead time by 30%. Metric: time from model acceptance in staging to declared production activation.

Stakeholders: Product: Aisha Patel (owner), Runtime PM: Claire Nguyen, SRE Lead: Ben Carter, Console PM: Rajesh Iyer, Solutions/CS: Maria Gomez, Engineering: Miguel Torres (assignee).

Risks & Mitigations:
- Risk: Model performance regressions slip through gating. Mitigation: mandate synthetic load canaries and token-cost delta thresholds; postpone activation if thresholds exceed.
- Risk: Capacity commitments not provisioned in time. Mitigation: include a 2-week provisioning buffer in the playbook and publish a per-model GPU-hour forecast.
- Risk: Overburdening teams with extra process. Mitigation: make templates minimal — checkbox gating and auto-populated dashboards where possible.

Notes: This playbook is intentionally componentized so we can reuse parts for Dedicated and Private later; initial focus remains Hosted API and the model catalog lifecycle.
